compiled_state.title: As an operator, direct non-merge commits to the session worktree during an active debug session are blocked by the existing pre-commit hook with an independent escape hatch
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Extend `check-session-merge-only.sh` to enforce session-merge-only when a `.debug-active` marker is present, with `DSO_DEBUG_ACTIVE=0` as an independent escape hatch. Update tests and CLAUDE.md rule 24.

**Why**: Sprint already protects session worktrees during sprint-active state. Debug sessions need the same protection so accidental direct commits don't bypass the per-sub-branch review path.

**Scope**:
- IN: Additive OR guard on `.debug-active` (existing `.sprint-active` path structurally unchanged); independent `DSO_DEBUG_ACTIVE=0` conditional block (NOT OR-extended into `DSO_SPRINT_ACTIVE`); when both markers are present, escape hatches behave as AND (require BOTH `DSO_SPRINT_ACTIVE=0` AND `DSO_DEBUG_ACTIVE=0` to permit commit); tests at `tests/hooks/test-check-session-merge-only.sh` for (a) `.debug-active` alone rejects non-merge, (b) both markers rejects, (c) `DSO_DEBUG_ACTIVE=0` permits, (d) both env vars set to 0 permits dual-marker state, (e) existing sprint-active tests still pass; CLAUDE.md rule 24 updated to reflect `.debug-active`, `DSO_DEBUG_ACTIVE=0`, and dual-marker AND semantics.
- OUT: Refactoring the hook architecture; new escape-hatch audit-log format (mirrors sprint's existing format).

## Done Definitions

- When complete, attempting a direct non-merge commit with `.debug-active` present and no escape-hatch env var is rejected by `check-session-merge-only.sh`
  ← Satisfies: "Direct non-merge commits to the session worktree are rejected by check-session-merge-only.sh when .debug-active is present"
- When complete, `DSO_DEBUG_ACTIVE=0` permits a direct non-merge commit during a debug-active state without affecting `DSO_SPRINT_ACTIVE` behavior
  ← Satisfies: "DSO_DEBUG_ACTIVE=0 escape hatch implemented as an independent conditional block"
- When complete, with BOTH `.sprint-active` AND `.debug-active` present, a direct non-merge commit is rejected unless BOTH `DSO_SPRINT_ACTIVE=0` AND `DSO_DEBUG_ACTIVE=0` are set (AND semantics for escape hatches)
  ← Satisfies: "Direct non-merge commits to the session worktree are rejected by check-session-merge-only.sh"
- When complete, existing sprint-active tests in `tests/hooks/test-check-session-merge-only.sh` still pass and 4+ new tests covering debug-active and dual-marker cases are added
  ← Satisfies: "Tests added at tests/hooks/test-check-session-merge-only.sh"
- When complete, CLAUDE.md rule 24 references both `.sprint-active` and `.debug-active` and documents the dual-marker AND-escape semantics
  ← Satisfies: "CLAUDE.md rule 24 updated to reflect .debug-active and DSO_DEBUG_ACTIVE=0 alongside existing sprint guidance"
- Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic
  ← Satisfies: "Tests added at tests/hooks/test-check-session-merge-only.sh"

## Considerations

- [Reliability] The existing `.sprint-active` code path must be structurally unchanged — any refactor of the hook to share marker-check logic must preserve the existing test suite end-to-end
- [Testing] Dual-marker test case is non-obvious and must be added explicitly; OR-vs-AND escape-hatch semantics is the most likely correctness regression

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
